description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'logreg_char' baseline: TF-IDF character n-gram featurizer + Logistic Regression.
model: logreg_char (TF-IDF character n-gram featurizer + Logistic Regression)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'logreg_char', group(s): linear); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
